conventions.ground: base on y=0, origin at the centre of the contact footprint

kinds.terrain: sub-region scale terrain piece (hill, dune, sea stack...)
kinds.ruin: comic catastrophe state on the stage-2 footprint (< 600 tris, <= 1.2 m)
kinds.scaffold: recovery state, posts + planks around a half-rebuilt s1 motif (< 400 tris, <= 1.3 m)
kinds.hero: growth hero stages g0..g3 (0.45/1.2/2.6/4.5 m; 300/600/1200/2500 tris) for families not covered by assets/growth/
kinds.shared: level-1 marker parts and shared props in assets/landmarks/shared/ (neutral cream, runtime tints)

conventions.variants: stage 2 ships three silhouettes per biome, variant a|b|c (files -s2, -s2b, -s2c); the runtime picks one by seed. Stages 1 and 3 have variant null

tags.decor: ground decor (discs, rocks): silhouette fill/distinctness check may be skipped

conventions.night: assets with a 'window' material slot list it under night.window_material; switch that material to emissive #ffe9a8 after dark (no separate night files)
conventions.materials: flat Principled BSDF colours exported as baseColorFactor, roughness 0.6, no textures, no extensions; material names are <id>-<colour role>; role 'window' (#ffe9a8) marks the warm facets to light at night

assets.name: castle keep
assets.motif_carried: gatehouse -> base arch, banner -> great banner

assets.name: temple waterfall
assets.motif_carried: idol -> carved face, torch -> four torches

assets.name: great works
assets.motif_carried: gear -> gable gear, conveyor -> entry belt
